recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to #f0f0f0.
2. Place title text "Example" at top-left in the header region (top-left to top-right) using large bold red (#c00000) sans-serif.
3. Place subtitle text "Better Weights" inside a green box directly below the title within the header region; use green (#008000) for the box and black (#000000) for the text.
4. Place slide number "31" inside a yellow (#ffff00) circle at the top-right of the header region with black (#000000) text.
5. Draw a red-bordered (#c00000) rectangle for the neural network diagram spanning top-center to mid-right (approx 20% to 90% width, 10% to 45% height).
6. Inside the diagram at the left, draw an input column vector with two rows: "x1 | 7 |" and "x2 | 4 |" in black (#000000) text.
7. Inside the diagram, draw three yellow (#ffff00) circles vertically for hidden nodes labeled "3", "4", "5"; place labels "O3", "O4", "O5" above them in black (#000000) text.
8. Inside the diagram, draw two orange (#ffa500) circles vertically for output nodes labeled "6", "7"; place labels "O6", "O7" to their right in black (#000000) text.
9. Draw green (#008000) weighted connection lines from the input vector to the hidden nodes with these labels: "0.121" and "0.405" to node 3; "0.101" and "0.305" to node 4; "0.099" and "0.295" to node 5.
10. Draw red (#ff0000) weighted connection lines from the hidden nodes to the output nodes with these labels: "-0.399" and "0.598" from node 3; "-0.288" and "0.696" from node 4; "-0.187" and "0.795" from node 5.
11. On the right side inside the diagram, add the label "Output" with values "O6" and "O7", and the label "Target" with a column vector "[0; 1]" and row labels "t6" and "t7" in black (#000000) text.
12. Place blue (#0000ff) bold italic text "Forward" at middle-left.
13. Place a blue-bordered (#0000ff) white-filled rectangle as the upper of two stacked boxes in the bottom-left net_calculations region (approx 5% to 45% width, 50% to 75% height) containing three lines with variable names in italic and numbers in regular: "Net3 = 7 * 0.121 + 4 * 0.405 = 2.146"; "Net4 = 7 * 0.101 + 4 * 0.305 = 1.626"; "Net5 = 7 * 0.099 + 4 * 0.295 = 1.574".
14. Place a second blue-bordered (#0000ff) white-filled rectangle as the lower of two stacked boxes in the same bottom-left region containing two lines with variable names in italic and numbers in regular: "Net6 = 0.895 * (-0.399) + 0.836 * (-0.288) + 0.828 * (-0.187) = -0.753"; "Net7 = 0.895 * 0.598 + 0.836 * 0.696 + 0.828 * 0.795 = 1.775".
15. Place a green-bordered (#008000) white-filled rectangle as the upper of two stacked boxes in the bottom-right output_calculations region (approx 65% to 95% width, 50% to 95% height) containing three lines with variable names in italic and numbers in regular: "O3 = 1 / (1 + e^2.146) = 0.895"; "O4 = 1 / (1 + e^1.626) = 0.836"; "O5 = 1 / (1 + e^1.574) = 0.828".
16. Place a second green-bordered (#008000) white-filled rectangle as the lower of two stacked boxes in the same bottom-right region containing two lines with variable names in italic and numbers in regular: "O6 = 1 / (1 + e^-0.753) = .32"; "O7 = 1 / (1 + e^1.775) = 0.855".
